document: Final learner-facing polish: remove review/development noise, eliminate narration repetition, simplify the teaching UI, preserve all provenance evidence.
statusReason: All required cleanup, unit, e2e, accessibility, audio-ownership, Explore-isolation, frame-drop and asset-integrity checks pass. Two of the six required visual checks in section 27 fail at 390x844 and 412x844: 'no panel covering the structure' and 'target anatomy remains dominant'. The cause is a pre-existing framing rule (the shot is fitted to the viewport's width), not a change made in this step. Fixing it means re-validating every framing against the frozen close-up spheres, which is camera architecture rather than learner-facing polish.
publicRelease: NOT CLAIMED. This build is not public-release ready.
